CustomField.formula: IF( FICO_Score__c > Old_Credit_Score__c ,"UP", IF(FICO_Score__c < Old_Credit_Score__c, "Down", IF(FICO_Score__c = Old_Credit_Score__c , "No Change", IF( AND(ISBLANK(Old_Credit_Score__c), FICO_Score__c > 0) , "New Score", "No Score") ) ) )
CustomField.label: Credit Score Direction
